latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — fast, AI-powered video editing for MacBook Pro users.

- Upload raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, ProRes up to 500MB) for quick, polished edits.
- AI automatically trims, adds transitions, and exports final videos in 1–2 minutes.
- No need to learn complex software; just describe your desired edits.
- Easy session management and token system for both registered and anonymous users.
- Supports export to 1080p MP4 and batch or iterative editing workflows.
